title: DR1 opens the upload-documents page with guidance on which documents are needed, including a table of extra documents by consignment type; the frontend page has none of it.

controls.text: Check which additional documents you must upload

finding.frontend: The page runs from the heading straight into the first question: h1 "Upload documents", then the Document reference input (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:16-39). Nothing tells the trader which documents this page is for, that an ITAHC is expected where the consignment needs one, that documents can be added later, that they must be in English, that every page must be uploaded, or that documents should be in before the consignment reaches the port. There is no disclosure and no link out to GOV.UK guidance.
finding.prototype: DR1 places three blocks between the heading and the form (app/views/upload-documents.html:37-82). First an introductory paragraph: "You must attach an ITAHC if this consignment requires one. If you do not have it now, you can add it later. All documents should be uploaded before the consignment arrives at the UK port. Documents must be in English and you must upload all pages." Then "Other documents you may need to attach include:" over two bullets — "import licences or authorisations" and "commercial documents or invoices". Then a closed disclosure, "Check which additional documents you must upload", holding a two-column table (Consignment / Documents needed) with three rows — animals that do not need a health certificate need an "Exporter's declaration that they are fit to travel"; livestock transiting bluetongue restricted territories need "Bluetongue declaration GBHC172"; rodents imported for research purposes need an "RM39 licence and supplementary health certificate" — followed by a "Check the documents you need" link to GOV.UK opening in a new tab.
finding.difference: Add the paragraph, the bulleted list and the disclosure to the upload-documents template, above the add-a-document form, using govukDetails and govukTable so nothing custom is introduced. All of it is static copy, so it lands in the feature's copy files with a Welsh counterpart; the three consignment rows are the only part that carries policy and should be confirmed as current before they are typed in. The GOV.UK link in DR1 carries analytics query parameters that must not be copied across — link to the plain guidance URL.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any of DR1's four statements — ITAHC expected, can be added later, must be in English, all pages — rendered anywhere in the frontend's documents journey.
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: searched both frontend rendered DOMs for "ITAHC", "English", "all pages" and "later" and found none of them; the frontend template really does run h1 at template.njk:16 into the Document reference govukInput at :31-39 with nothing between. Checked every quoted string against the DR1 DOM and the dr1-upload-documents screenshot rather than the page model, and all of it is verbatim — the introductory paragraph word for word, "Other documents you may need to attach include:" over its two bullets, the closed details summary "Check which additional documents you must upload", and the three table rows with "Exporter's declaration that they are fit to travel", "Bluetongue declaration GBHC172" and "RM39 licence and supplementary health certificate" under the Consignment / Documents needed headings. The warning about the link is well founded: DR1's href carries a _gl analytics query string onto the GOV.UK guidance URL. CORRECT.
